desc: Task 1: Parse N and the binary string A of length 3^N.
Task 2: Build the ternary tree bottom-up. Store dp0 and dp1 for each node (minimum flips to make node 0 or 1).
Task 3: For leaves, set dp0/dp1 based on the character.
Task 4: For internal nodes, compute dp0 and dp1 using the "at least 2 of 3 children must equal target" rule, taking min over all combinations.
Task 5: Determine current root value (the one with cost 0) and output dp[root][1 - current].
Task 6: Write final Python code with fast I/O and verify on sample inputs.
